# apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment_localization (Resource)

Adds a locale to a product page optimization treatment, to give it screenshots and previews of its own: use the resource's `id` as the `experiment_treatment_localization_id` of `apple_app_asset_library_placement`. A locale without a localization shows the original product page's media. Destroying the resource deletes the localization with its placements. Import it by ID or with `<treatment_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment_localization" "en_US" {
  treatment_id = apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment.orange.id
  locale       = "en-US"
}

# A screenshot only this treatment shows.
resource "apple_app_asset_library_placement" "orange" {
  image_id                             = apple_app_asset_library_image.orange.id
  experiment_treatment_localization_id = apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment_localization.en_US.id
  placement_type                       = "APP_SCREENSHOT"
  placement_group                      = "IPHONE_DYNAMIC_ISLAND_LARGE_PROFILE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `treatment_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the treatment, e.g. `apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment.example.id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the treatment localization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment_localization.en_US
  identity = {
    id = "8e9f0a1b-2c3d-4e5f-8a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the treatment localization.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> or <treatment_id>/<locale>
terraform import apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment_localization.en_US 5d7c1b2a-3e4f-4a5b-9c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d/en-US
```
